citations.locator: Eastern Churches, 6. Uniat Church of Malabar
citations.excerpt: There is also a Catholic Church of Malabar formed by the Synod of Diamper in 1599.
Out of the entire body of 200,000 Syrian Christians only some 400 individuals remained faithful.

facts.value: The Catholic Saint Thomas Christians of Malabar, to whom the Holy See granted native bishops.

citations.excerpt: During this period the Holy See decided on a change of regime, yielding to the wishes of the people to grant them native bishops .

facts.value_before_verify: The Catholic Saint Thomas Christians of Kerala, under Latin bishops until the Holy See granted native bishops in three vicariates in the 1890s.
